Mode.Name: What the wheel changes
Mode.Hint: "Image scale" only enlarges the token artwork, keeping the grid cells it occupies. "Grid size" changes its width and height on the grid.

ScaleStep.Name: Scale step
ScaleStep.Hint: How much the image scale changes per wheel notch (0.05 = 5%).

SizeStep.Name: Grid size step
SizeStep.Hint: How many grid units the token grows or shrinks per wheel notch.

AllowPlayers.Name: Allow players
AllowPlayers.Hint: Players can resize tokens they own. Otherwise only the GM can.

Modifier.Name: Modifier key
Modifier.Hint: Key to hold while scrolling over a token. (Ctrl and Shift alone already rotate tokens.)

Reset.Name: Reset token to original size
Reset.Hint: Applies to the hovered token, or to the selected tokens.

Notifications.NothingToReset: This token already has its original size.

Errors.Update: Could not resize the token (see F12 console).
Errors.Reset: Could not reset the token size (see F12 console).
